title: GHOST TRACK update 2: the one with cameras and such
author: _Fauxpaw
selftext:
GHOST TRACK is a space fleet game where you run intelligence for a battlefleet through CRT consoles and camera feeds. Reports can be wrong, so you send drones to look and visually confirm things, for Captain's to autonomously act on your fleet picture.

*New this week*:

\- **Multicam**: Warships now have multiple camera points on them. Turret cams, chase cams, aft/stern cams.. switch between them at will!

\- **Multispot**: Multiple spot monitors now exist instead of just one!

\- **Patchboard**: Run physical cords to pick which camera shows on which spot.

\- **Staff Officers**: The Threat Analyst and Recon & Drone staff officers now exist. The TA works your Alert queue, one at a time, and proposes a choice of action among those available. You can also ask your TA about something and they will prioritize it. The Recon & Drone officer adds to your Alert queue by claiming cameras and piloting them out to look at signals and visually confirm them for you.

\- **Drone Limits**: Fly a drone out of range, and it loses its link. Then it blows itself up on a timer, so it can't be claimed by the enemy.

\- **First Sounds**: Key clicks, captain's acknowledge orders, and the thump of your guns and of hits. They're just stand-ins for now.

\- **Tooltips**: We got 'em! They are now diegetic to the game, under the pretense of a training aid to whoever is using the console.

\-----

As to my workflow, it's primarily all done with Claude using Matt Pocock skills. My lab-forward design has also been a tremendous boon; this week's standouts are the [turret lab](https://claude.ai/artifact/YUZh4LbihYxecLVJoECa2U) and the [tooltip lab](https://claude.ai/artifact/8b65YgG4HRcYc9VBiCCThq) (*the keys in the tooltip lab are fun to press..*). I also have a subscription to Gemini that I've been using to prompt my own brain with ideas, and run reviews on PRs.
